contentFull:
Coming soon: Webinar on sow mortality, longevity and productivity

Taking good care of pigs starts with giving their mothers the best attention possible. That is why themes like sow longevity, sow productivity and sow mortality are receiving increasing attention – including in an upcoming webinar on Thursday, 10 September. 

Vincent ter BeekEditor of Pig Progress / Topic: Pigs around the world

Aug 27

News

Picture: Shutterstock/Hendrix Genetics 

Together with Hendrix Genetics Swine, Pig Progress will enter the studio with 2 expert speakers to further delve into this topic. 

Sow longevity is influenced by a complex combination of physiology, management and genetics. Understanding how these factors interact is essential for improving both herd performance and animal welfare.

Register here to attend the webinarExpert speakers

The webinar will feature Dr Carlos Piñeiro, CEO of Animal Data Analytics, Spain, and Garret Weber, sales manager, US, Hendrix Genetics Swine. Together they will explore what makes sows more resilient throughout their productive lives.

Using data, biological insights and practical field experience, they will examine the key drivers behind sow mortality and early removal from the herd. The speakers will also share practical approaches to support balanced sows, stronger welfare and consistent herd performance. 

Starting times of the webinar

The webinar, starting at 3pm CET, is free to attend. This corresponds to the following times in other time zones:

translationZh:
即将举行：关于母猪死亡率、长寿性和生产力的网络研讨会

照顾好猪，首先要给予母猪最好的关注。因此，母猪长寿性、生产力和死亡率等主题正受到越来越多的关注——包括即将于9月10日（星期四）举行的网络研讨会。

母猪长寿性受到生理、管理和遗传等因素的复杂组合影响。理解这些因素如何相互作用，对于改善猪群性能和动物福利至关重要。

**专家演讲者**

本次网络研讨会将邀请西班牙Animal Data Analytics首席执行官Carlos Piñeiro博士和美国Hendrix Genetics Swine销售经理Garret Weber。他们将共同探讨如何使母猪在整个生产周期中更具韧性。

利用数据、生物学见解和实际现场经验，他们将分析母猪死亡和提前淘汰的关键驱动因素。演讲者还将分享支持母猪均衡生产、提升福利和保持猪群稳定性能的实用方法。

**网络研讨会开始时间**

研讨会于欧洲中部时间下午3点开始，免费参加。对应其他时区的时间如下：
